pr.description:
Unified PR lifecycle CLI — creation, CI failures, code review, and review comments

When to use: Managing PR lifecycle: opening a PR, checking CI status, running reviews, addressing comments, or viewing unified PR status

Usage: pr create [--draft] [--no-verify] [--dry-run] [--base <branch>] [--title <text>] [--body <text> | --body-file <path>] [--issue <id>] [--closes <id>]  |  pr status  |  pr ci [--run <id>] [--fix] [--post] [--wait] [--wait-timeout <sec>] [--wait-interval <sec>]  |  pr review [--no-post] [--submit] [--self] [--fix] [--push] [--skip-user-verification] [--force] [--no-holistic] [--no-scout] [--no-group] [--no-synthesis] [--no-disprove] [--disprove] [--json-summary] [--issue <url>] [--base|--onto <base>] [--max-parallel <n>] [--max-cost <usd>] [--model <name>] [--effort <low|medium|high>] [--max-groups <n>] [--generated] [-V|--version] [--post] [--repair] [--summary] [--recover] [--list] [<pr|branch> ...]  |  pr comments [--triage] [--fix] [--no-verify] [--finish] [--track <thread-id>] [--track-all] [--post] [--reply <thread-or-comment-id>] [--body-file <path>] [--settle <thread-id>] [--as <fixed|dismissed|already_addressed>] [--reason <text>] [--commit <sha>]  |  pr fix [--post] [<review-or-ci-flag> ...]  |  pr rebase [--onto|--base <ref>] [--fork-point <ref>] [--fix] [--no-push] [--push-only] [--no-verify] [--force] [--abort]  |  pr describe [--force] [--dry-run] [--post]  |  pr batch plan --checkout <dir>  |  pr batch run --checkout <dir> | --plan <file> [--steps <steps>] [--pool <pool>] [--auto-publish <steps>] [--prs <prs>] [--select <key=steps>]  |  pr batch resume [<run-id>]  |  pr batch resolve --action <action> [--reason <reason>] [--body-file <body-file>] [--commit <commit>] <run-id> <decision-id>  |  pr batch cancel [--kill] [<run-id>]  |  pr batch status [<run-id>]  |  pr gc
